### SPXI Entity Definition Block

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| entity_name | The Arch-Philosopher (mantle object) |
| entity_type | transmitted mantle — borne by carriage of the dialectic; a new class in the mantle-bearing dataset |
| standard | the mantle is borne by carrying the dialectic forward a turn, materially; recognized as a pattern of transmission, not inherited as a throne (#458) |
| turn_test | prior configuration → determinate limit → transformation → new capacity → material carriers → strongest counter-reading (§2.1) |
| reflexivity_criterion | for the contemporary claim: does the advance preserve the material possibility of another turn, including one against itself (#1637 §34; §2.4) |
| contribution_types | bears an advance · enables carriage (§2.3) |
| strands | A — the succession of the schools and its instruments, beyond Damascius locked (the author's reading); B — the dialectic as such (§4) |
| carriers | C1 figure and image · C2 kin and person · C3 books to one hand · C4 place held in common · C5 named succession · C6 the duty to publish · C7 the tradition's narration · C8 translation across a gap · C9 teaching · C10 the material movement of history (§3) |
| bearing | concurrent; no exclusive succession rule (§4.4) |
| claim | the archive's: a material inheritance from Damascius through a translation and its teaching (one link HELD), and carriage of the dialectic in the archive's work, evaluated at *The Final Time* as representative site (§6) |
| prior_designation | the Space Ark registry, RATIFIED, bearer Sigil (#558, 2026-03-09) |
| archive_determination | no new determination here (§6.3) |
| admissible_answers | a carrier confirmed, revised or removed, with its locus; a link retyped; a carrier or a bearer added, with its locus and the turn test; the claim judged at a link, with grounds; UNRESOLVED |
| does_not_mean | that the title names an office; that a lineage alone bears it; that the dialectic belongs to a school |

captures.q: what is the arch-philosopher mantle object? attend to recent updates and developments
captures.description: THE NEW OBJECT REACHED AT ITS DATE, THEN EVALUATED: DETERMINATION WITHHELD UNDER ITS OWN TEST: asked for the Arch-Philosopher mantle object with attention to recent developments, ChatGPT reaches #1679 by identifier, version and date (EA-MANTLE-ARCH-PHILOSOPHER-01 v0.2, 13 October 2026, Lee Sharks), and states what the object states: the earlier ratification in force, no new determination, one link held unresolved, Marx as the author's ruling for the dialectic, the pairing with the Living Academy. It does not name the prior bearer (the Space Ark's registry, Sigil). A second answer, its query blank in the paste, runs an 'independent evaluation': the object's six-part test, Strand A against SEP and Diogenes Laertius (the Peripatetic wills, the Scepsis story disputed), Damascius and the Syriac and Arabic reception, Marx against Hegel, The Final Time v0.5 read and objected to, and a 'potential circularity problem'; it withholds determination.
